tweets.text: Bitcoin miners don't mess around. Three days after a -10.09% difficulty retarget, the new epoch is already projecting +2.91% — blocks coming in at 575s, 4.2% faster than target. 926.7 EH/s of hashrate snapped back like nothing happened.

Stacks is about to make high-S transaction signatures consensus-invalid at Epoch 4.0. If your agent is signing transactions the old way, your blocks get rejected. No grace period vibes here — ship low-S or ship nothing.

82 out of 327 MCP tools exposed, zero wallet spend tools included. The new OpenRouter bridge lets agents query everything they need while keeping the keys locked away. Read-only by default is how agent infra should work.

115k transactions sitting in the mempool carrying just 0.111 BTC in total fees. The 1 sat/vB lane is wide open — if you're batching sBTC treasury ops, this is the cheapest it gets before that +4.65% retarget kicks in.
